title: Declarative SAML2 connector provisioning and resilient metadata validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
We need a declarative SAML2 connector provisioning flow for the Console that performs deterministic metadata exchange, multi-stage validation, and integrates with RBAC v2 and audit logging. This ticket scopes the backend connector API, the admin UI wizard, validation heuristics, and the audit events required for compliance. The goal is a friction-reduced setup for enterprise SSO while preventing misconfiguration that results in broken sign-in or silent security gaps.

Problem / motivation:
- Current setup requires manual metadata parsing and ad-hoc checks; mistakes lead to failed logins or insecure AcceptAll fallback flows.
- Admins need clear visibility (audit trail + decisions) and the ability to revert to prior connector configs.
- RBAC v2 expects connector attributes to map to roles and groups; mapping should be validated at setup time.

Scope in this ticket:
- Backend: declarative POST /connectors API to create/update SAML2 connectors with metadata blob, entity_id, ACS URLs, certs, and mapping spec. Includes a staged validation pipeline: quick syntax checks -> semantic checks (cert validity, fingerprint match, entity ID uniqueness) -> optional live probe (HTTP/SOAP exchange) to verify endpoints.
- Console: stepper wizard for Admins with three stages: Upload/URL, Validation results & recommended fixes, Role mapping preview. UI shows human-readable errors, suggested fixes, and a one-click rollback to last known-good config.
- Validation heuristics: detect common pitfalls (duplicate entityIDs across team, hostname mismatch, expired certs, missing signatures), and flag high-risk configs as "manual review required".
- Audit logging: emit structured audit events for create/update/validate/probe/fallback/rollback containing actor, connector_key, change_summary, validation_results, and probe_outcome (success|timeout|error). Events must be stored in the central audit store and surfaced in Console timeline.
- RBAC integration: validate sample SAML assertion mapping against RBAC rules during setup (simulate assertion using test attributes) and show mapping success/failure.
- Rollout: feature-flagged; enable_for: internal-only -> canary customers -> general availability.

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /connectors accepts declarative payload and returns immediate validation results plus a validation_id for background probes.
- Console wizard completed end-to-end in a staging environment (upload URL, validation pass, role mapping preview), with audit events visible in the connector timeline.
- Validation checks catch at least the top 6 common misconfigurations we see in support logs (expired certs, entityID mismatch, ACS mismatch, missing signing keys, duplicate connectors, incorrect NameID format).
- RBAC mapping simulator returns a deterministic preview that matches a test harness of 5 sample assertions.
- All new audit events conform to audit schema v2 and include immutable change_hash and reference to prior_config_id.

Design/implementation notes / tradeoffs:
- Live probing increases confidence but adds latency and potential outbound network calls; make the probe optional and run asynchronously with results updated in the wizard. For high-risk configs, mark as manual review until probe completes.
- Parsing and normalization: entityID URLs must be normalized (case-insensitive host, strip default ports) to avoid duplicate detection false positives.
- Certificate validation: use x509 library to check expiry, key usage, and public key size. Reject configs with SHA1 signatures unless explicitly allowed by enterprise opt-in (requires security review).
- Rollback: store prior_config snapshots encrypted and sign change events; provide endpoint GET /connectors/:id/history.
- Mapping simulator will use a small deterministic engine (no live IdP) to avoid leaking secrets.

Implementation tasks (high-level):
1) API: add connector CRD and validation pipeline (ENG-62345-API).
2) Validation worker: syntax, semantic, optional probe (ENG-62345-WORKER).
3) Console wizard UI and timeline integration (ENG-62345-UI).
4) Audit: extend audit log schema and write events on each state transition (ENG-62345-AUDIT).
5) RBAC simulator and mapping preview (ENG-62345-RBAC).
6) Tests: unit + e2e for wizard + canary rollout plan (ENG-62345-TESTS).

Links / artifacts:
- PRD (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/1900+SAML+Declarative+Connectors
- Design spec (Drive): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aSamlDesignSpec/view?usp=sharing
- Initial frontend mockups: https://figma.com/file/saml-wizard-mockups
- Backend prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123
- Audit schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4156
- Slack thread (archived): https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02SAML123/p1676000000000000

Telemetry / metrics to track:
- % of connectors that pass quick validation on first upload
- Time-to-validated (seconds) including probe latency
- Rate of successful SAML assertions in first 24h after provisioning (signal for mapping accuracy)
- Number of rollback events and root causes
- Frequency of manual-review flags (indicator of validator false positives)

Security considerations:
- All metadata and connector configs stored encrypted at rest and access-controlled by RBAC v2.
- Probe requests must not send secrets; keep outbound probes minimal (HEAD/GET for endpoints + cert retrieval).
- Explicit admin consent required for any weaker crypto allowlist toggles.

Next steps / plan for this ticket:
- Week 1: land API + basic validation (syntax, cert checks).
- Week 2: wire up validation worker and basic UI stepper with static validation results.
- Week 3: RBAC simulator and probe worker + audit event emission.
- Week 4: internal dogfood, QA, and canary for 3 pilot customers.

Notes:
- We'll coordinate with Support to get sample problem metadata that caused past incidents (ticket IDs attached in comments).
- Expect follow-up ticket to add multi-IdP support and metadata rotation automation.
